raw: {"clause_type": "payment_terms", "obligation": "pay a deductible of US$5,000 within five Business Days of receiving the claim notice", "party_responsible": "the Insured", "trigger_condition": "a covered loss occurs", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "data_protection", "obligation": "implement and maintain appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Personal Data", "party_responsible": "the Borrower", "trigger_condition": null, "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "aml_kyc", "obligation": "implement enhanced AML procedures, obtain independent verification of the counter‑party, and submit a detailed AML compliance report", "party_responsible": "the Borrower", "trigger_condition": "if any Borrower‑initiated transaction under the Syndicated Loan Facility exceeds USD 5,000,000", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "termination", "obligation": "terminate the loan agreement upon an Event of Default", "party_responsible": "the Lender Parties", "trigger_condition": "occurrence of an Event of Default", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "confidentiality", "obligation": "keep Confidential Information strictly confidential and not disclose to third parties without consent or legal requirement", "party_responsible": "the Insured", "trigger_condition": "receipt of Confidential Information from the Insurer or its Affiliates", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "compliance_covenant", "obligation": "submit a certified compliance report demonstrating continued minimum 8% Tier 1 capital requirement", "party_responsible": "the Borrower", "trigger_condition": "any material change in its regulatory capital adequacy ratio", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "regulatory_reporting", "obligation": "submit a detailed report of all derivative transactions executed under the Agreement", "party_responsible": "the Counterparty", "trigger_condition": "within thirty (30) days after the close of each calendar quarter", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "termination", "obligation": "terminate the Agreement", "party_responsible": "the Client", "trigger_condition": "CloudServe Ltd fails to achieve the agreed Service Level Objectives for three consecutive months", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "indemnification", "obligation": "indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Client and its Affiliates from losses arising from the Custodian's breach of representations, unauthorized data access or privacy law violations", "party_responsible": "the Custodian", "trigger_condition": "any breach by the Custodian of its representations, warranties or obligations under Sections 4.2, 7.1 and Schedule B of this Data Processing Agreement, any unauthorized access to, alteration of or disclosure of the Client’s digital asset data caused by the Custodian’s negligence or willful misconduct, or any claim that the Custodian’s processing of Personal Data violates applicable Indian privacy law", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "force_majeure", "obligation": "notify the Administrative Agent within five Business Days of a Force Majeure Event and suspend repayment obligations for up to thirty days", "party_responsible": "the Borrower", "trigger_condition": "a Force Majeure Event materially prevents the Borrower from performing its obligations", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "regulatory_reporting", "obligation": "provide customer identification information to the relevant authority within five business days", "party_responsible": "The Firm", "trigger_condition": "receipt of a regulatory request for customer identification information", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "force_majeure", "obligation": "limit liability for failure or delay caused by uncontrollable events", "party_responsible": "Neither Party", "trigger_condition": "occurrence of any such event", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "regulatory_reporting", "obligation": "furnish a detailed compliance report to the Regulatory Oversight Committee", "party_responsible": "the Insurer", "trigger_condition": "receiving any regulatory notice from the Dubai Financial Services Authority relating to the Microfinance Leasing Portfolio", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "liability_cap", "obligation": "limit the Service Provider's aggregate liability to the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve months preceding the claim", "party_responsible": "the Service Provider", "trigger_condition": null, "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "confidentiality", "obligation": "keep client onboarding information confidential and not disclose to third parties except as required by law or regulatory request", "party_responsible": "the Company", "trigger_condition": null, "risk_flag": "low"}

{"clause_type": "regulatory_reporting", "obligation": "file required transaction reports, suspicious activity notifications and periodic compliance statements with Singaporean regulators and furnish copies to the FinTech Payments Provider within the prescribed timeframes", "party_responsible": "the Correspondent Bank", "trigger_condition": "upon request made in writing no later than five (5) business days after the filing date", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "payment_terms", "obligation": "remit any amount received from the Originating Bank to the Beneficiary within one business day after receipt", "party_responsible": "The Respondent Bank", "trigger_condition": "receipt of a valid SWIFT MT103 message confirming the transaction", "risk_flag": "low"}
{"clause_type": "aml_kyc", "obligation": "conduct ongoing customer due‑diligence checks and sanctions screening", "party_responsible": "The Insurer", "trigger_condition": null, "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "indemnification", "obligation": "indemnify and hold harmless the Correspondent and its Affiliates from losses arising from the Bank's breach of obligations", "party_responsible": "the Bank", "trigger_condition": "any breach by the Bank of its obligations under Sections 4.1, 7.3(b) and Schedule B", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "aml_kyc", "obligation": "conduct identity verification, screen the investor against sanctions lists and obtain source‑of‑funds documentation", "party_responsible": "the Manager", "trigger_condition": "receiving any New Investor Subscription", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "force_majeure", "obligation": "suspend performance for the duration of the event", "party_responsible": "the affected Party", "trigger_condition": "failure of either Party to perform its obligations caused by an event of force majeure", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "data_protection", "obligation": "implement and maintain data protection measures and notify the Client of any Personal Data breach", "party_responsible": "the Service Provider", "trigger_condition": "any Personal Data breach that is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects", "risk_flag": "high"}

{"clause_type": "payment_terms", "obligation": "remit the quarterly performance fee within five Business Days after invoice receipt", "party_responsible": "the Investment Manager", "trigger_condition": "receipt of a valid invoice", "risk_flag": "medium"}

{"clause_type": "indemnification", "obligation": "indemnify and hold harmless the Insurer against any Losses arising from a breach of the confidentiality obligations", "party_responsible": "the Manager", "trigger_condition": "a breach of the confidentiality obligations set forth in Clause 7", "risk_flag": "high"}
